text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
"Hello, little bird. ...Yes, I can hear 
you. Did you need something from me?"

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
...Well, what a lovely invitation. 
Unfortunately, I don't have wings... so 
let's play somewhere closer to the ground, 
shall we?

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Oh... Would it be alright if Squirrel-san 
joins us? Just like you, they are a 
resident of the courtyard.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
She hoarded a ton of acorns, so the other 
day she mentioned wanting to throw a 
party. ...She's usually on her own, it 
seems.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
I'm certain you will become wonderful 
friends. ...Fufu. I shall make sure to be 
there as well.
